description: List the values a filter field may take in a report query: the closed set for an enum field (status, type, priority, …), or real ids with their names for an id field (programId, initiativeId, codebaseId, teamId, …; the first 100). When the person named a program, initiative, codebase or team, pass that name as `query` to look it up among every row. Use the values verbatim in query filters; never invent an id. Requires `read` scope and a role that edits reports.

field.description: The filter field, as named in the catalog (e.g. status, programId).

query.description: Optional: a name to look up among an id field's rows.

source.description: The data source, as named in the catalog (e.g. workItems, initiatives, program).

name: anyforge_list_report_filter_values
title: List report filter values
